title: Paul's 'not by works but by faith' = not by legal covenant observance but sincere gospel faith
source_text: XXXV. Quoties ergo affirmat Apostolus nos non justificari operibus, sed fide, non aliud docere intendit, quam nullum omnino justificari posse per observationem legis, quam foedus legale postulat, ut per illud vitam habeamus, & vitemus Dei maledictionem: sed Deum pro justis habere, ac remissionem peccatorum omnium ex mera sua gratia donare, omnes illos qui corde syncero Evangelium suscipiunt, illique veram ex fide praestant obedientiam.
pass_a_gloss: Therefore whenever the Apostle affirms that we are not justified by works but by faith, he intends to teach nothing other than that no one at all can be justified by observing the law as the legal covenant requires so that through it we may have life and avoid God's curse: but that God holds as just, and from his mere grace grants remission of all sins to, all those who with sincere heart receive the Gospel and render it true obedience from faith.
pass_b_english: Paul's contrast: not legal-covenant perfect observance, but sincere gospel faith with its obedience.
God freely remits and counts just those who receive the gospel from the heart.

choices.english: not justified by works but by faith
